ei.title: 수능유형픽 독해기본 미니테스트 MT1-5번 (hedgehog's dilemma / 순서배열)
ei.subject: 수능유형픽독해기본

fullPassage: Imagine two hedgehogs in winter. If they keep close together, they'll stay warm; but each may also be injured by the other's sharp spines. This is known as the hedgehog's dilemma, and it's possible to view human relationships the same way. It can feel good to have a close relationship with someone. Unfortunately, this also puts you in danger of hurting that person and having your own feelings wounded. For example, you may often become angry with your mom or your best friend. You may even say mean things to them, expecting them to understand that you are just upset. On the other hand, you're probably more forgiving of people who you aren't close with. So, what is the solution? Should you keep close relationships and risk hurting each other? Or should you remain remote from everyone and live in loneliness? It's important to find the right balance in your relationships. Showing respect to your loved ones is probably a good start.
